title: stream
description: Physics frame from the PF, up to 30 Hz (protocol.md section 9): sim time t, position, attitude, the mixed velocity set, control surfaces, on_ground and the profile's stream vars (lv_<name>). Latest wins: the server drops a frame not newer than the last one from the same PF and relays to every other client without seq. Never logged per frame, never replayed. (both directions)

frame.description: Counts up on the sending bridge, never repeats.

data.description: Field names and units: protocol.md section 9. The bridge ignores (and counts) a frame without its required fields.

from.description: Set by the server when relaying.
